###############################################################################
## Created by Sean Hartery (Nov. 12, 2019)
##
##  Voyage ID: TAN1802
##
##  Vessel: R/V Tangaroa
##
##  Location: Southern Ocean/Ross Sea
##
##  Period: February 17 - March 18, 2018
##
##  Detailed Description:
##  ---------------------
##  Number-concentration size spectra of ambient aerosol were measured 
##  from a container laboratory on the R/V Tangaroa in February/March 2018. 
##  The voyage departed and returned to Wellington, New Zealand, spending 
##  the majority of the sampling period in the Ross Sea. Spectral measurements 
##  were made using a PCASP-100X spectrometer. The spectra were corrected 
##  according to size-dependent losses through the inlet line 
##  (Brockman, 2001). A modal analysis was then used to constrain the 
##  concentration of sea spray from the spectra (Modini et al., 2015; 
##  Quinn et al., 2017).
##
##  Relative wind speeds were measured using a Gill WindSonic anemometer. 
##  These were corrected according to acceleration factors over the ship's 
##  hull (Popinet et al., 2004) and translated according to the ship's heading 
##  and velocity to derive the True wind speed and direction. Finally, the true
##  velocities were adjusted from the measurement height (22.5 m) to the 10-m 
##  reference level according to the local stability and logarithmic wind 
##  profile (COARE3.5; Edson et al. 2013).
##
##  References:
##  -----------
##  Brockman, J. (2001). Sampling and transport of aerosols. 
##      In P. A. Baron & K. Willeke (Eds.), Aerosol measurement: 
##      Principles, techniques, and applications (2nd ed., 
##      pp. 143-197). Hoboken, NJ: John Wiley and Sons, Inc.
##
##  Edson, J. B., et al. (2013). On the exchange of momentum over
##      the open ocean. Journal of Physical Oceanography, 43(8), 
##      1589-1610.
##
##  Modini, R. L., et al. (2015). Primary marine aerosol-cloud 
##      interactions off the coast of California. Journal of 
##      Geophysical Research: Atmospheres, 120(9), 4282-4303.
##
##  Popinet, S., Smith, M., & Stevens, C. (2004). Experimental 
##      and numerical study of the turbulence characteristics 
##      of airflow around a research vessel. Journal of 
##      Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology, 21(10), 1575-1589.
##
##  Quinn, P. K., et al. (2017). Small fraction of marine cloud 
##      condensation nuclei made up of sea spray aerosol. Nature 
##      Geoscience, 10, 674-679.
##
##  Quality Assurance:
##  ------------------
##  Hourly measurements were only included in the following data 
##  set if:
##
##      1/ The ambient Relative Humidity was less than 98%
##
##      2/ The accumulated precipitation was less than 1 mm
##
##      3/ CO2 measured by a Picarro was less than 405 ppm.
##
##      4/ The influence of continental aerosol (excluding Antarctica)
##         was negligible as determined by back-trajectory analysis.
##
##  Index - Variable [ units ]
##  ------------------
##  0     - UTC Date/Time [ YYYY/mm/dd HH:MM:SS ]
##  1     - Latitude  [ deg ]
##  2     - Longitude [ deg ]
##  3     - Number Concentration of Sea Spray Particles [ cm^-3 ]
##  4     - 10-m Wind Speed [ m s^-1 ]
##
###############################################################################
